title: Hepatic stellate cell subpopulations in human MASLD-related hepatocellular carcinoma upregulate YAP via geranylgeranyl pyrophosphate.
snippet: Hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) drive cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Statin use decreases cirrhosis and HCC through unclear mechanisms.
